system.description: Spend three Blood Traits to activate, then one Blood Trait per turn to maintain, gaining an extra action every turn (a further Blood Trait grants one more, to a maximum of two bonus actions). All incoming lethal and aggravated damage is halved, round up, with a single point of such damage before halving ignorable entirely on a won Simple Test; the first two health levels of any bashing attack are automatically ignored. All of your attacks deal one additional health level of damage regardless of type. Leaves no visible sign of use and stacks with Celerity, Fortitude, Potence, and other Protean powers.
system.bloodCost: Three Blood Traits to activate, one per turn to maintain (plus more for extra actions)
